requirement.description: The hashlib.keccak_256 function is not available in the current Python environment, causing AttributeError in EIP712 tests.
requirement.contract: Update the keccak function in hashes.py to properly handle environments where hashlib.keccak_256 is not available by falling back to alternative implementations like pysha3 or pycryptodome.

requirement.description: The transaction standardization process is not properly handling gas_price field conversion, causing KeyError in transaction signing tests.
requirement.contract: Ensure the standardize_transaction function correctly handles gas_price field conversion to gasPrice to match Ethereum transaction format requirements.

requirement.description: Configuration keys mismatch between spec.config_keys and the actual Config type annotations, causing test failure in config keys validation.
requirement.contract: Align the config_keys list in spec/__init__.py with the actual keys defined in Config, PartialConfig, and JsonConfig type definitions.
